title: Sources: Microsoft plans to remove most of its Claude Code licenses and push its developers toward GitHub Copilot CLI, after previously pushing Claude Code (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Sources: Microsoft plans to remove most of its Claude Code licenses and push its developers toward GitHub Copilot CLI, after previously pushing Claude Code — Thousands of Microsoft developers will use GitHub Copilot CLI instead — Microsoft first started opening up access to Claude Code in December …
contentText:
Tom Warren / The Verge :

Sources: Microsoft plans to remove most of its Claude Code licenses and push its developers toward GitHub Copilot CLI, after previously pushing Claude Code   —  Thousands of Microsoft developers will use GitHub Copilot CLI instead  —  Microsoft first started opening up access to Claude Code in December …
